text:
anika: Pushed a new staging build of the Prompt Sets & Evals test-suite page. URL in the doc — please prioritize UX feedback around: scorecard density, the new compact list, approval workflow copy, and keyboard/a11y. Screenshot + prototype in the drive link.

matt: Quick pass — the scorecard cards feel tall on 1440px. Maybe we move model/version & last-run into a single header line to reduce vertical rhythm. Also the inline diff chip is easy to miss.

jules: Agreed with matt. Also the pass/fail chips are low-contrast for users with low vision. Contrast check shows the green on white is ~2.8:1. We should hit at least 3:1 for non-text UI but aim for 4.5:1 for clarity.

lena: Copy nits on the approval modal: current header says "Approve changes" which is vague. Suggest: "Approve prompt set changes for production" and the secondary line should summarize the diff count (e.g., "3 changed prompts, 1 removed").

sara: Accessibility note — keyboard focus stops at the card action menu but not on the inline diff toggle. We need tabindex on the diff toggle and an aria-expanded with a concise label. Example: `button.diff-toggle[tabindex=0 aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="diff-123"]`

matt: For compact mode, can we provide a density toggle in the top-right of the page instead of burying it in settings? Makes A/B easier and reduces discoverability issues.

anika: Good calls. Regarding the diff chip visibility, what about adding a small colored bar on the card edge plus a hover tooltip that summarizes the change? That should increase salience without changing layout. Thoughts?

jules: Love the bar idea. For keyboard users the bar needs an accessible name — `role="img" aria-label="has diff"` or include the summary in the card's accessible description.

lena: Approval workflow — we also need an explicit undo button after approval. Lots of teams want a quick rollback for accidental approvals. Suggest adding a 30s toast with "Undo" + a full audit trail link.

sara: One more microcopy tweak: change the CTA from "Run" to "Run test suite" in the modal to reduce ambiguity for new users.

anika: OK actionable list: 1) Reduce scorecard vertical spacing (matt) 2) Improve diff salience with edge bar + tooltip + keyboard focus (jules + sara) 3) Fix contrast on pass/fail chips (jules) 4) Change approval modal copy and add undo toast + audit link (lena) 5) Add density toggle in page header (matt) 6) CTA copy tweak (sara). I'll file tickets after this thread.

designbot: Ticket summary generated: UI-721 (scorecard spacing), UI-722 (diff edge bar + a11y), UI-723 (contrast fixes), UI-724 (approval modal + undo), UI-725 (density toggle), UI-726 (CTA copy).

matt: Can we get a small mock of the compact header change in Figma? I'll pair with design for the spacing patch.

anika: I'll drop the Figma frames and link them here by EOD. Also scheduling a quick 20-min sync tomorrow for decisions — invite sent.

jules: One more accessibility ask: ensure the diff summary is present in the exported CSV/scorecard report so screen-reader users get equivalent info.

anika: Noted. Adding to UI-722. Thanks all — great feedback.
